_comment: mem0 provider behavioral config (tracked reference). Hermes reads $HERMES_HOME/mem0.json. Primary mode is self-hosted OSS on pgvector (the docker-compose mem0-postgres service). Platform fallback: set MEM0_API_KEY in ~/.hermes/.env and switch mode to 'platform' (design Q6). Secrets are NEVER stored here.

oss_config._comment: Self-hosted mem0 SDK against pgvector. Embedder is a local HuggingFace model (no external key required); the LLM fact-extractor uses the local Ollama endpoint. Swap embedder/llm to openai by adding the keys to ~/.hermes/.env if preferred.

platform_fallback._comment: Used only if mode is switched to 'platform'. Reads MEM0_API_KEY from env.
